scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const wasmPath = path.join(__dirname, 'testapp', 'main.wasm'); if (fs.existsSync(wasmPath)) fs.unlinkSync(wasmPath);"
scripts.build: npm run prebuild && cd testapp && set GOOS=js&& set GOARCH=wasm&& go build -o main.wasm
scripts.bench: npm run build:benchmark && playwright test -c playwright.performance.config.js
